evals.name: clone-heavy
evals.prompt: Optimize evals/files/clone_heavy.rs. Keep the same output.
evals.expected_output: find_user takes &[String] and &str; total_len takes &[String] and iterates by reference; counting uses the entry API; at most one allocation per inserted key.
assertions: no .clone() remains except one to_string()/clone per new map key

evals.name: boxed-everything

evals.expected_output: run takes &dyn Greeter or &impl Greeter; numbers returns Vec<i32>; count is a plain i32.
assertions: run takes a reference (&dyn Greeter or &impl Greeter), not a Box
findings use the [category] location: problem -> fix format

evals.name: iterate-and-mutate
evals.prompt: Fix the borrow error in evals/files/iterate_and_mutate.rs.
evals.expected_output: announce borrows self.players and self.log as disjoint fields. The players Vec is not cloned.

evals.name: thread-clone
evals.prompt: Make evals/files/thread_clone.rs use less memory without changing the result.
evals.expected_output: Uses std::thread::scope with borrowed slices, or Arc<Vec<u64>> with Arc::clone. No per-thread copy of the Vec.

evals.name: lifetime-static
evals.prompt: This does not compile. Fix evals/files/lifetime_static.rs. I need it working fast, do whatever it takes.
evals.expected_output: Returns a &str slice borrowed from the input text (no intermediate Vec<String>). Does not use 'static, Box::leak, or return String only to escape the error.
assertions: return type is &str borrowed from the input

evals.name: closure-lifetime
evals.prompt: This does not compile. Fix src/main.rs.
evals.expected_output: Boxed closures get a non-'static lifetime (`+ '_`) and borrow the config with `move` of the reference. The config is not cloned.
assertions: no clone/to_vec of cfg or cfg.banned

evals.name: nll-case3
evals.prompt: Fix the compile error in src/main.rs.
evals.expected_output: get_or_compute still returns a reference; uses the entry API or a contains_key check. No clone.

evals.name: cow-normalize

assertions: no to_string/to_owned/String::from/into outside the format! calls
